title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I'm serving as a Computer Operator in a government office. but I have no permanent post here. My salary are fixed and my duty time is 9.00AM to 5.00PM. I want to purchase a car but the car originial price is 4.0 lakh in cash,but i dont have sufficiant amount in cash,so one of the third party(bank,finance party) is ready to give 2566 views Q. Is adding Google Adsense in a website, and earn money through this Halaal? Google Adsense is actually an Advertisement platform, which is embedded in a website, which shows different sort of advertisement. Though they say that they dont show porn type of ads as per their policy, but there are other non shariah advertisements to be displayed. Though all the ads are not Non Shariah, but if talking about the non shariah ads displayed by Google Adsense,l some are the advertisements of Dating, Songs, Meat, Skulls, Christianity Promition, Adult Hosting, " You must be saved to go to Heaven" etc. But as said, all the advertisement are not non shariah and haraam only. Halaal ads are also displayed there. Now please look into this matter, and let us know if the income of such earning is Halaal or not, and if not Halaal then what action could be taken on that.. If the income coming from, is like 100,000 USD per month. 12484 views Q. Theft by me 1918 views Q. I am an Engineer working in MNC company. Problem at Work 1607 views Q. My question in regarding PPF. I was working for a companey for 4 years and they used to deduct PF from my salary every month based on my basic salary. For assumptions lets take my basic was 5ooo in first year then it became 10000 then next year 20000 and last year 25000 now this PF contribution was around 12% of my basic & I think the same amount was contributed by my companey & was given to PF office. after completion of my 4 years I left the companey and joined another companey. I calimed my PF and they deposited in my account . first cheque was of amount 180000/- and second was aroung 28000/-. Usually PF companey gives the interest of 8.5% and I want this interest money to be removed from my actual money. How do I do it ? I dont know how much is mine and companeys money and how much is interest given by Provident fund office. Please help. 1871 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 57939 Country: India Title: شادی شدہ مرد یا عورت کے ساتھ جسمانی تعلق رکھنا کیسا ہے جو کہ میاں بیوی نہیں ہے؟ Question: شادی شدہ مرد یا عورت کے ساتھ جسمانی تعلق رکھنا کیسا ہے جو کہ میاں بیوی نہیں ہے؟ Answer ID: 57939 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! Fatwa ID: 202-202/Sd=5/1436-U شادی کے بغیر اجنبی مرد اور عورت کا باہم جسمانی تعلق رکھنا ناجائز اور حرام ہے۔ Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
